candidate_requirements.requirement: Request current brain MRI (with susceptibility/gradient-echo sequences) to characterise the progressive syndrome and residual vascular changes.
candidate_requirements.rationale: Imaging is explicitly unsupplied and is the primary discriminator among neurodegenerative, vascular, and other structural causes of a progressive cognitive-language syndrome.
candidate_requirements.acceptable_alternatives: CT with contrast if MRI unavailable; comparison with any prior post-haemorrhage imaging.
candidate_requirements.deadline: Proposed as an immediate next investigation in the written plan.

candidate_requirements.requirement: Request CSF biomarkers including prion-directed testing (e.g., RT-QuIC) and neurodegenerative/Alzheimer markers where available.
candidate_requirements.rationale: The childhood cadaveric pituitary-derived growth hormone exposure plus a rapidly progressive cognitive syndrome raises a prion disease hypothesis that CSF testing could help address; biomarkers are explicitly unsupplied.
candidate_requirements.acceptable_alternatives: 14-3-3 protein if RT-QuIC unavailable; clinical judgement may defer lumbar puncture depending on findings.
candidate_requirements.deadline: Proposed within the written next-evidence plan.

candidate_requirements.deadline: Proposed within the written next-evidence plan.
